data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Mobile Menu Panel
levels.description: Multi-layer smooth shadow creating depth for slide-out navigation panel. Uses 6 layered shadows with varying blur and opacity values for realistic depth.

levels.name: Polaroid Image Shadow
levels.description: Soft subtle shadow for polaroid-style images. 5px blur with light gray color at 75% opacity.

levels.name: Form Autofill Inset
levels.description: Large inset shadow used to override browser autofill styling. Creates a cyan background effect via inset shadow.
